mn110:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
mn110:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadahuposathe paṇṇarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti.
mn110:2.2: atha kho bhagavā tuṇhībhūtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ anuviloketvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn110:3.1: jāneyya nu kho bhikkhave, asappuriso asappurisaṃ,
mn110:3.5: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ asappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya,
mn110:3.11: etampi kho bhikkhave, aṭṭhānaṃ anavakāso, yaṃ asappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya
mn110:4.1: asappuriso bhikkhave asaddhammasamannāgato hoti, asappurisabhattī hoti, asappurisacintī hoti, asappurisamantī hoti, asappurisavāco hoti, asappurisakammanto hoti, asappurisadiṭṭhī hoti, asappurisadānaṃ deti.
mn110:5.2: idha bhikkhave, asappuriso assaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottappī hoti, appassuto hoti, kusīto hoti, muṭṭhassati hoti, duppañño hoti.
mn110:5.3: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, asappuriso asaddhammasamannāgato hoti.
mn110:6.2: idha bhikkhave, asappurisassa ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā assaddhā ahirikā anottappino appassutā kusītā muṭṭhassatino duppaññā tyāssa mittā honti te sahāyā.
mn110:6.3: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, asappuriso asappurisabhattī hoti.
mn110:7.2: idha bhikkhave, asappuriso attavyābādhāyapi ceteti, paravyābādhāyapi ceteti, ubhayavyābādhāyapi ceteti.
mn110:7.3: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave asappuriso asappurisacintī hoti.
mn110:8.2: idha bhikkhave, asappuriso attavyābādhāyapi manteti, paravyābādhāyapi manteti, ubhayavyābādhāyapi manteti.
mn110:8.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, asappuriso asappurisamantī hoti.
mn110:9.2: idha bhikkhave, asappuriso musāvādī hoti. pisuṇavāco hoti. pharusavāco hoti. samphappalāpī hoti.
mn110:9.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, asappuriso asappurisavāco hoti.
mn110:10.2: idha bhikkhave, asappuriso pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, kāmesumicchācārī hoti.
mn110:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, asappuriso asappurisakammanto hoti.
mn110:11.3: ‘natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammā paṭipannā, ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
mn110:11.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, asappuriso asappurisadiṭṭhī hoti.
mn110:12.2: idha bhikkhave, asappuriso asakkaccaṃ dānaṃ deti, asahatthā dānaṃ deti, acittīkatvā dānaṃ deti, apaviddhaṃ dānaṃ deti, anāgamanadiṭṭhiko dānaṃ deti.
mn110:12.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, asappuriso asappurisadānaṃ deti. sa kho
mn110:13.1: so bhikkhave, asappuriso evaṃ asaddhammasamannāgato, evaṃ asappurisabhattī, evaṃ asappurisacintī, evaṃ asappurisamantī, evaṃ asappurisavāco, evaṃ asappurisakammanto, evaṃ asappurisadiṭṭhī,
mn110:13.2: evaṃ asappurisadānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā yā asappurisānaṃ gati, tattha uppajjati.
mn110:14.1: jāneyya nu kho bhikkhave, sappuriso sappurisaṃ
mn110:14.5: ṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave, vijjati yaṃ sappuriso sappurisaṃ jāneyya
mn110:15.2: etampi kho bhikkhave, ṭhānaṃ vijjati yaṃ sappuriso asappurisaṃ jāneyya
mn110:15.4: sappuriso bhikkhave, saddhammasamannāgato hoti, sappurisabhattī hoti, sappurisacintī hoti, sappurisamantī hoti, sappurisavāco hoti, sappurisakammanto hoti, sappurisadiṭṭhī hoti,
mn110:16.2: idha bhikkhave, sappuriso saddho hoti, hirimā hoti, ottappī hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, upaṭṭhitasatī hoti, paññavā hoti.
mn110:16.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, sappuriso saddhammasamannāgato hoti.
mn110:17.2: idha bhikkhave, sappurisassa ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhā hirimanto ottappino bahussutā āraddhaviriyā upaṭṭhitasatino paññavanto, tyāssa mittā honti te sahāyā.
mn110:17.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, sappuriso sappurisabhattī hoti.
mn110:18.2: idha bhikkhave, sappuriso nevattavyābādhāya ceteti, na paravyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayavyābādhāya ceteti.
mn110:18.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, sappuriso sappurisacintī hoti.
mn110:19.2: idha bhikkhave, sappuriso nevattavyābādhāya manteti, na paravyābādhāya manteti, na ubhayavyābādhāya manteti.
mn110:19.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, sappuriso sappurisamantī hoti.
mn110:20.2: idha bhikkhave, sappuriso musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisunāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti. samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti.
mn110:20.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, sappuriso sappurisavāco hoti.
mn110:21.2: idha bhikkhave, sappuriso pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti.
mn110:21.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, sappuriso sappurisakammanto hoti.
mn110:22.3: ‘atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, atthi hutaṃ, atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthi ayaṃ loko, atthi paro loko, atthi mātā, atthi pitā, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
mn110:22.4: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, sappuriso sappurisadiṭṭhī hoti.
mn110:23.2: idha bhikkhave, sappuriso sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ deti, sahatthā dānaṃ deti, cittīkatvā dānaṃ deti, parisuddhaṃ dānaṃ deti, āgamanadiṭṭhiko dānaṃ deti.
mn110:23.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, sappuriso sappurisadānaṃ deti. sa kho
mn110:24.1: so bhikkhave, sappuriso evaṃ saddhammasamannāgato, evaṃ sappurisabhattī, evaṃ sappurisacintī, evaṃ sappurisamantī, evaṃ sappurisavāco, evaṃ sappurisakammanto, evaṃ sappurisadiṭṭhī,
mn110:24.2: evaṃ sappurisadānaṃ datvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā yā sappurisānaṃ gati, tattha uppajjati.
mn110:25.2: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
mn110:26.4: puṇṇakā dve iti paṭhamo asamo varavaggo.
